questions.prompt: What does the term battery refer to?
options: A cell or several cells linked
questions.why: A battery can be a single cell or several cells connected together.
questions.quote: A battery refers to a single cell or several cells connected together.

questions.prompt: Which of these can serve as a source of electrical energy?
questions.why: Generators and solar panels are sources of electrical energy.
questions.quote: Other energy sources include a generator and a solar panel.

questions.prompt: What is the first condition for an appliance to work?
questions.why: The first condition is a source of electrical energy.
questions.quote: The first condition for an appliance to work is the presence of a source of electrical energy.

questions.prompt: Are the switches in a keyboard normally open or closed?
questions.why: The switches in keyboard keys are kept open until pressed.

questions.prompt: What parts does a switch contain?
questions.why: A switch has both conducting and insulating parts.
questions.quote: There are conducting and insulating parts in the switch (Fig 8.7).

questions.prompt: What do standard circuit symbols represent?
questions.why: Standard circuit symbols represent different circuit components.
questions.quote: We use some standard circuit symbols to represent different circuit components of a circuit.

questions.prompt: What should be placed at each wire junction when drawing a circuit diagram?
questions.why: A solid dot marks each wire junction in a circuit diagram.
questions.quote: Put a solid dot at each wire junction.

questions.prompt: Is a switch a necessary component to form a complete circuit?
questions.why: A switch is not required; a complete circuit needs only a source and a closed loop.
questions.quote: A switch is a necessary component to form a complete circuit.

questions.prompt: What happens to a torch when its switch is opened?
questions.why: Opening the switch breaks the circuit, so the torch goes off.
questions.quote: (b) when the switch is open, the circuit is incomplete and the torch goes off

questions.prompt: What happens if an LED is connected directly to the cell?
questions.why: Connecting the LED directly to the cell can damage it.
questions.quote: Never connect the LED to the cell directly. Otherwise, the LED will be damaged.
